connections.description: External connections, one values layer per connection file. Not used by this chart.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

username.title: Username
username.description: Basic auth user of the filer UI.

password.title: Password
password.description: Basic auth password of the filer UI. No default: a password shipped with a chart ends up in production.

rootAccessKey.title: Root access key
rootAccessKey.description: Access key of the store's root (Admin) identity, used by the bucket provisioning.

rootSecretKey.title: Root secret key
rootSecretKey.description: Secret key of the root identity. No default.

consoleHost.title: Console host
consoleHost.description: Host name of the filer UI, the ingress suffix is appended. Default: seaweedfs-<namespace>.

apiHost.title: S3 API host
apiHost.description: Host name of the S3 API, the ingress suffix is appended. Default: seaweedfs-<namespace>-api.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: S3 identities, one per principal. Its keys are read by ESO from credentialsSecret (a Secret of this namespace). actions are SeaweedFS verbs (Read, Write, List, Tagging, Admin), scoped to buckets when buckets is set; sts marks a principal allowed to assume the STS role (SeaweedFS only grants it to an Admin identity).

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Buckets created at startup. paths seeds prefixes for consumers that require them to exist beforehand.

outputSecretRef.title: Published credentials Secret
outputSecretRef.description: secretRef of the published s3 connection, a Secret consumers can use (e.g. one replicated to every namespace). Empty: none, each consumer brings its own identity.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

seaweedfs.title: seaweedfs
seaweedfs.description: Values of the seaweedfs chart 4.47.0 (https://seaweedfs.github.io/seaweedfs/helm), for example image, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, master/volume/filer/s3 settings, ingress annotations. Refused: nameOverride, fullnameOverride, master.enabled/port, volume.enabled/resizeHook, filer.enabled/port/s3, filer.ingresses.http.enabled/className/host/tls and its nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-* annotations, s3.enabled/port/enableAuth/existingConfigSecret/extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts, s3.ingress.enabled/className/host/tls, the s3 annotation secret.reloader.stakater.com/reload, sftp, allInOne, networkPolicy.enabled, cosi. Appended to the lists this chart sets: s3.createBuckets, s3.extraArgs.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
